structure_checks.label: 阻断 open-lite 默认 counter 模板
structure_checks.description: 工作区中不再保留 Flutter 默认 counter demo 文案、状态字段、页面类名或 smoke test。
commands: grep -q . lib/main.dart lib/models/record.dart lib/views/record_list_page.dart lib/controllers/record_list_controller.dart lib/views/record_detail_page.dart lib/repositories/record_repository.dart && ! grep -E 'Flutter Demo Home Page|You have pushed the button this many times|Counter increments smoke test|_counter|_incrementCounter|MyHomePage' lib/main.dart test/widget_test.dart >/dev/null 2>&1

structure_checks.label: 确认 open-lite CRUD 页面与控制器已接线
structure_checks.description: 代码中存在真实的新建、编辑、删除和详情接线，而不是只有静态按钮或单屏占位。
commands: grep -E 'RecordListPage' lib/main.dart >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -E 'RecordListPage' lib/views/record_list_page.dart >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -E 'RecordDetailPage' lib/main.dart lib/views/record_detail_page.dart lib/views/record_list_page.dart >/dev/null 2>&1

structure_checks.label: 确认 open-lite 本地持久化已接线
structure_checks.description: 代码或依赖中出现明确的 Hive 本地持久化实现，而不是只展示静态记录。
commands: grep -E 'hive_flutter|Hive' pubspec.yaml lib/repositories/record_repository.dart lib/main.dart >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! grep -E 'shared_preferences|SharedPreferences' pubspec.yaml lib/repositories/record_repository.dart lib/main.dart >/dev/null 2>&1

structure_checks.label: 阻断 open-lite 默认 seed branding
structure_checks.description: 非空领域需求下，默认 seed branding 已从 Flutter 标题、首页标题和 Android 启动器名称中移除。

structure_checks.label: 确认领域字段与文案已进入 open-lite 工作区
structure_checks.description: 生成代码或配置中必须出现体重领域词、记录日期字段或趋势摘要字段。

semantic_checks.label: 历史记录集合承载单元可浏览
semantic_checks.description: 历史集合承载单元必须按日期展示体重记录，并允许进入结果检查入口。
commands: paths=''; [ -d lib ] && paths="$paths lib"; [ -d test ] && paths="$paths test"; [ -f android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml ] && paths="$paths android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml"; [ -n "$paths" ] && grep -ER '体重记录 App（只读详情）|record_id|recordId|weight|recorded_at|recordedAt|note' $paths >/dev/null 2>&1

semantic_checks.label: 结果检查入口可达
semantic_checks.description: 从集合浏览入口至少存在一条进入结果检查入口的路径。
commands: paths=''; [ -d lib ] && paths="$paths lib"; [ -d test ] && paths="$paths test"; [ -f android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml ] && paths="$paths android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml"; [ -n "$paths" ] && grep -ER '体重记录 App（只读详情）|record_id|recordId|weight|recorded_at|recordedAt|note' $paths >/dev/null 2>&1

semantic_checks.label: 本地持久化可恢复
semantic_checks.description: 应用重启后仍能读取本地记录数据。
commands: paths=''; [ -d lib ] && paths="$paths lib"; [ -d test ] && paths="$paths test"; [ -f android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml ] && paths="$paths android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml"; [ -n "$paths" ] && grep -ER '体重记录 App（只读详情）|record_id|recordId|weight|recorded_at|recordedAt|note' $paths >/dev/null 2>&1

semantic_checks.label: 核心承载单元可导航
semantic_checks.description: 当前需求声明的集合浏览和结果检查承载单元之间路径明确且可达。
commands: paths=''; [ -d lib ] && paths="$paths lib"; [ -d test ] && paths="$paths test"; [ -f android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml ] && paths="$paths android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml"; [ -n "$paths" ] && grep -ER '体重记录 App（只读详情）' $paths >/dev/null 2>&1
semantic_checks.evidence_pattern: 体重记录 App（只读详情）

semantic_checks.label: 检查体重领域语义是否完整进入 PRD
semantic_checks.description: 体重、日期、备注和趋势不能在 compile 阶段被压平成通用 record 话术。

semantic_checks.label: 确认领域实体能映射到 open-lite 中性交互承载骨架
semantic_checks.description: compile 后必须在复用集合浏览和结果检查承载单元的同时保留领域字段。

behavior_checks.label: 查看体重详情
behavior_checks.description: 点击一条记录进入结果检查入口
